title: Weekly sync - Oct 8
text:
Date: <mention-date start="2026-10-08"/> · Notes: **Wop testwell**
Attendees: Maya Chen, Daniel Ortiz, Priya Raman, Sam Okafor, Wop testwell, Tomas Rivera (video)
## Updates
- **Daniel:** Matching v0.3 is on staging. 87% of students matched within a minute, but the API is slow with 200+ students.
- **Sam:** Push notifications don't arrive on Android 15. Looks like a missing permission request.
- **Priya:** Icon vote done - the overlapping speech bubbles won. Onboarding redesign (7 screens down to 4) is ready for review.
- **Tomas:** 12 beta testers interviewed. Top request: book a library study room from the app.
- **Maya:** Pitch to Harbor Seed Fund partners done. Lena asked for user numbers.
## Decisions
- Remove the "about you" screen from onboarding
- Database migration on Saturday, October 17, 11 PM - 1 AM ET
- Library room booking is **not** in scope for the Nov 2 launch
## Action items
- [ ] Sam: fix the Android 15 notification bug (2-3 days)
- [ ] Daniel: get API response time under 1 second
- [ ] Wop: send the migration notice to beta testers on Friday
- [ ] Maya: send beta numbers to Lena
- [ ] Tomas: ask Westbrook library staff about their booking system
